subtitle.zh: SPRING 品牌｜骨骸系列首饰与视觉设计
subtitle.en: SPRING | Skeleton Collection 3D Jewellery & Visual Design

description.zh: 为 SPRING 品牌设计视觉识别与骨骸系列首饰，将骨骼结构转化为 choker、项链与戒指。
description.en: Visual identity and skeletal jewellery for SPRING, translating anatomical forms into chokers, necklaces, and rings.

kind.zh: 品牌视觉／3D 首饰设计

coverAlt.zh: 佩戴银色骨骸首饰的深色人体模型，额部展示戒指，颈部与胸前展示首饰。
coverAlt.en: A dark mannequin wearing silver skeletal jewellery, with a ring displayed on the forehead and jewellery at the neck and chest.

role.zh: 品牌视觉、Logo 设计与骨骸系列 3D 打印首饰开发
role.en: Brand visual identity, logo design, and 3D-printed Skeleton Collection jewellery development

stage.zh: 品牌视觉、首饰造型与三维可视化
stage.en: Brand identity, jewellery forms, and 3D visualisation

deliverables.zh: SPRING 字标、品牌视觉、首饰造型与佩戴渲染
deliverables.en: SPRING wordmark, brand visuals, jewellery forms, and on-body renders

overview.zh: SPRING 是以 Remake 服装与实验性首饰设计为核心的亚文化服饰品牌。项目期间，我参与品牌视觉设计、Logo 设计以及「骨骸系列（Skeleton Collection）」3D 打印首饰开发，构建从品牌视觉到产品设计的完整创作体系。
overview.en: SPRING is a subculture fashion brand centred on remake clothing and experimental jewellery. I contributed to its visual identity, logo design, and the development of 3D-printed jewellery for the Skeleton Collection, connecting brand expression with product design.

paragraphs.zh: 肋骨向两侧展开，以骨节连接中央结构。
paragraphs.en: Ribs open to either side, joined by a central sequence of bones.

paragraphs.zh: 人像位于中央，骨骼曲线与链条环绕其外缘。
paragraphs.en: A central human effigy is surrounded by skeletal curves and chains.

paragraphs.zh: 细长骨线组成翼状轮廓，在中央交汇。
paragraphs.en: Slender skeletal lines form wings that converge at the centre.

paragraphs.zh: 上部骨刺向两侧张开，下部沿脊柱向下延伸。
paragraphs.en: Upper spurs spread sideways while a spinal sequence extends below.

paragraphs.zh: 四向骨刺形成镜像结构，环形镂空穿过中央。
paragraphs.en: Four mirrored spurs surround openings through the central form.

paragraphs.zh: 胸腔般的骨架围合中央，尖刺沿外轮廓延伸。
paragraphs.en: A thoracic structure encloses the centre, with spurs along its outline.

paragraphs.zh: 层叠肋骨逐渐收束，向下延伸出单一尖端。
paragraphs.en: Layered ribs narrow into a single descending point.

paragraphs.zh: 宽阔骨翼连接纵向骨节，形成向下生长的轮廓。
paragraphs.en: Broad skeletal wings connect to a descending spinal chain.

paragraphs.zh: 曲线与尖刺相互穿插，构成开敞的环形结构。
paragraphs.en: Interlocking curves and spurs create an open circular structure.

paragraphs.zh: 弧形肋骨包围中轴，骨节穿过中央留白。
paragraphs.en: Curved ribs surround an axis of bones through an open centre.

paragraphs.zh: 侧向骨翼与细长脊柱连接，在末端再次分叉。
paragraphs.en: Lateral bone wings meet a slender spine that branches at its tip.

paragraphs.zh: 红色嵌入元素沿中轴排列，与银色骨骼形成对照。
paragraphs.en: Red inset elements follow the central axis against silver skeletal forms.

paragraphs.zh: 人像、肋骨与骨节叠合，形成一件纵向结构。
paragraphs.en: A figure, rib structures, and vertebrae combine in a vertical composition.

paragraphs.zh: 骨架层层展开，细链连接两侧的转折。
paragraphs.en: Layered skeletal forms are joined by fine chains at either side.

paragraphs.zh: 弧形结构从两侧抬起，向中央尖端汇聚。
paragraphs.en: Raised curved sides converge towards a central point.

paragraphs.zh: 角状骨刺沿横向伸展，环形结构连接下方。
paragraphs.en: Horn-like spurs spread horizontally above a connected loop.

paragraphs.zh: 重复骨节串联成排，弯曲的分支从中伸出。
paragraphs.en: Repeated joints form a row with curved branches emerging from it.

paragraphs.zh: 人像上方伸出角状结构，环与骨刺沿四周连接。
paragraphs.en: Horn-like forms rise above a figure, surrounded by loops and spurs.

paragraphs.zh: 镂空骨翼相对展开，尖端收束为镜像轮廓。
paragraphs.en: Open skeletal wings face one another, tapering into mirrored tips.
